universities.name: Kalasalingam Academy of Research and Education
universities.summary: Kalasalingam Academy of Research and Education (KARE) is a private deemed-to-be university under Section 3 of the UGC Act 1956 in Krishnankoil, Virudhunagar district, Tamil Nadu. Founded in 1984 as Arulmigu Kalasalingam College of Engineering and notified as a deemed university in 2006, it teaches engineering, agriculture, law, management, sciences and arts, and awards its own degrees.
universities.campusLifestyle: KARE's Krishnankoil campus covers 163 acres at the foot of the Western Ghats. KARE's NIRF 2025 data records 9,937 students on undergraduate and two-year postgraduate programmes in 2023-24, including 514 from outside India, plus 818 Ph.D. scholars. The air-conditioned central library covers 1,02,000 sq ft and holds 1,07,000 volumes. The campus has a swimming pool, a health centre, an ATM and a post office.
universities.cityProfile: Kalasalingam Academy of Research and Education (KARE) is at Anand Nagar, Krishnankoil, in Virudhunagar district of southern Tamil Nadu (PIN 626126). Madurai International Airport (IXM) is 65 km from campus, about 60 minutes by road. Srivilliputtur railway station (SVPR), linked to Madurai Junction, is 25 km away, and Krishnankoil bus station is 2 km away. KARE runs 40 buses and two vans on routes to Krishnankoil, Srivilliputtur, Rajapalayam, Sivakasi, Madurai and Watrap.
universities.practicalExposure: KARE's NIRF 2025 data reports that 1,422 of the 1,593 four-year undergraduate students who graduated in 2023-24 were placed, at a median salary of INR 5,75,000 a year, and 84 went on to higher studies. On two-year postgraduate programmes, 229 of 271 graduates in 2023-24 were placed at a median of INR 5,75,000 a year. KARE runs engineering programmes in collaboration with IBM, Siemens, the Automotive Research Association of India and Nano Chip Solutions, and TCS-linked B.Sc., BCA and B.Com. programmes. Under MoUs with foreign universities, KARE students can spend one or two semesters abroad while paying only KARE tuition.
universities.hostelOverview: KARE has four men's hostels and three women's hostels inside the Krishnankoil campus, plus a separate international hostel. The 2026-27 hostel tariff for resident Indian students runs from INR 80,000 a year for a five-bed non-AC room to INR 1,40,000 a year for a four-bed AC room with attached bathroom. KARE publishes no separate hostel tariff for NRI or foreign students. Rooms are allotted first-come, first-served.
universities.dietarySupport: Hostel food at KARE is catered by Sodexo and includes vegetarian and non-vegetarian meals. Students take part in preparing the menu, and the hostels have a general store.
universities.safetyOverview: KARE hostels have 24x7 CCTV surveillance, biometric attendance, an on-campus medical room with ambulance access and a student help desk. KARE runs an Anti-Ragging Committee, an Internal Complaints Committee and a Women Empowerment Cell.
universities.studentSupport: KARE's International Relations Office (directorirl@klu.ac.in) handles international admissions and student exchange. The admissions centre is open 9 a.m. to 5 p.m., Monday to Saturday, except major Indian holidays.
whyChoose: NRI and foreign B.Tech tuition for 2026-27 is USD 4,000 a year for CSE and IT, USD 2,500 for ECE and Biotechnology, and USD 2,000 for other branches.
NIRF 2025 ranks KARE 28th in the university category and 33rd in engineering.
KARE has MoUs with more than 100 foreign institutions, and students on a semester abroad pay only KARE tuition.

faq.answer: Kalasalingam Academy of Research and Education (KARE) is a private deemed-to-be university. It was founded in 1984 by T. Kalasalingam under the Kalasalingam and Anandam Ammal Charities trust.

faq.answer: Kalasalingam Academy of Research and Education (KARE) holds a NAAC A++ grade with a CGPA of 3.51 in its third accreditation cycle, declared on 14 February 2024. NIRF 2025 ranks KARE 28th among Indian universities.

faq.question: What is the B.Tech fee at Kalasalingam?
faq.answer: For 2026-27, B.Tech tuition at Kalasalingam Academy of Research and Education (KARE) for resident Indian students is INR 1,95,000 a year for CSE, AI and DS, and IT, INR 1,60,000 for ECE and Biotechnology, and INR 1,00,000 for other branches, plus INR 12,000 a year in miscellaneous fees. NRI and foreign students pay USD 4,000, USD 2,500 or USD 2,000 a year respectively, plus a one-time USD 150 admission fee and USD 150 a year in miscellaneous fees, with no scholarship.

faq.question: Is there an entrance exam for Kalasalingam?
faq.answer: Yes, for domestic admission. Kalasalingam Academy of Research and Education (KARE) shortlists B.Tech applicants on KUEE or JEE Main, M.Tech applicants on GATE or KEEE, and integrated law applicants on CLAT or KLSAT; most arts, science and management programmes use the Kalasalingam Common Entrance Examination with Class 12 marks. KARE publishes no separate entrance-test rule for international applicants who apply through Study in India.

faq.question: How far is Kalasalingam from Madurai?
faq.answer: Kalasalingam Academy of Research and Education (KARE) is 65 km from Madurai International Airport, about 60 minutes by road. The nearest railway station is Srivilliputtur, 25 km away, and KARE buses run to Madurai.

faq.question: Does Kalasalingam admit international students?
faq.answer: Yes. Kalasalingam Academy of Research and Education (KARE) admits international students through the Government of India's Study in India portal, and NRI and foreign applicants pay a USD 50 application fee for 2026-27. In October 2024 the Ministry of Education told institutions that foreign students would need a Study in India ID in their student visa application from 2025-26.

faq.question: Is hostel compulsory at Kalasalingam?
faq.answer: Kalasalingam Academy of Research and Education (KARE) does not state that hostel residence is compulsory. Its seven hostels are inside the Krishnankoil campus, and rooms are allotted first-come, first-served at INR 80,000 to INR 1,40,000 a year for resident Indian students in 2026-27.
